rationale: With only 26 minutes to close, LOGI is trading in a tight consolidation range (last 5 candles all within ~$0.20) near the lower 20% of today's range after a large gap-down on earnings. The price action shows no clear directional momentum — alternating closes with diminishing range — and the stock is sitting between the 9-EMA ($98.40) and VWAP ($99.49) without a clean breakout signal in either direction. The elevated relative volume (4x) and end-of-day liquidation risk make a forced exit at market close a meaningful concern, and the reward/risk ratio for a 26-minute trade in this choppy, post-earnings environment does not justify committing capital.
